title: StructuredClone / GetterCarrier Addrof Leak
detail: ds-addrof.js corrupts the getterCarrier function array slot via MessageChannel structured clone deserialization, yielding high-reliability 64-bit object address leaks across WebKit versions without reliance on DFG JIT.

title: Arbitrary Read/Write Fake Object Alignment
detail: ds-composition.js aligns fake array butterfly pointers at delta 0x10 from host address, constructing a synthetic TypedArray backing store that provides stable, non-destructive arbitrary 64-bit memory read/write.

title: Pure Bytecode Libkernel Stub Scanner
detail: kernel-stubs.js scans a 0x20000 window around getpid export (0xb8 opcode) to extract syscall IDs (getpid, close, pipe, unlink, thr_self) with 100% deterministic matching across 23 firmwares.

title: FW 13.60 Verified Offset Table
detail: offsets/offsets.json contains exact verified offsets for FW 13.60 (hc=[0x1e0d8, 0x1e320, 0x1f368], gd=0x1d11a, nt=0x4740, gps=0x34f57b8, gpe=0x1b860, cls=0x34f57a8, cle=0x274e0).

title: 12 On-Device Research Payloads Fully Wired
detail: The payload suite in payloads/*.js covers process diagnostics, memory canary inspection, API error code checks, sysmodule loading, IPMI daemon IPC fuzzing, AVPlayer demux probing, and libSceXml parser dispatching.

title: libSceAvPlayer MP4 Box Size Gate Tests
detail: video-test.html and media/evil_st*.mp4 provide test cases targeting 32-bit count truncation in stts/stco/stss/stsz atom demuxing.

title: Standalone Offline Host Server Suite
detail: host/ provides DNS spoofing (fakedns.py), HTTP/HTTPS serving (host.py), appcache manifest generation for offline execution, and binary memory dump collection (dumpserver.py).

title: Non-blocking Live Telemetry Pipeline
detail: telemetry.js and telemetry_logger.py implement a dedicated TCP trace streaming pipeline to avoid DOM garbage collection pressure on WebKit during intense memory exploration.
